verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say it automatically detects AMD GPUs and downloads a matching backend, so AMD acceleration is covered at a basic level. Nothing in the pack mentions Vulkan or says whether that AMD backend avoids a full ROCm install, so the story's defining element is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of a Vulkan backend, evidence that AMD acceleration works without ROCm, setup/config details for Vulkan, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AMD performance.
